plugins.author: The Combat Reborn Team
plugins.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugins.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
plugins.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.author: Berna, kai, Kiri
plugins.name: Congratulations
plugins.punchline: Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.
plugins.description:
Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.

Comes with default sounds for when you get commended by 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 or all seven members of the duty you were in, but you can set custom sounds for each type of trigger by opening /congratsconfig.

The fractioned values are in relation to how many of those members could commend you (i.e. excluding those that were in your party before joining the duty).
plugins.changelog:

  - Add GP regeneration alert (Off by default)
  - Add background on rotation display (On by default, can be turned off on configuration)

rawManifest.TestingChangelog:
[Pet Nicknames 3.0.0.0]

Helloooo helloooooo!
This is a majour rewrite of Pet Nicknames that has been ongoing for the last year.
Sorry this took so long.

- Added support for Beast Master naming.
- Added an ephemeral chat replace (on by default) where chat messages will update retroactively and disappear when the plugin turns off.
- Massive stability improvements, naming is now much more consistant, and lots of UI elements will update themselves.
- Slight UI rework.
- Added multiple languages (If your language is missing, feel free to message me). [French (Matias49), Japanese (Epinephren), German (Epinephren), Chinese (MapleRecall), Dutch (Glyceri), English (Glyceri)] 
- It *should* now work on the non-global clients too.
- Added support for LOVM (I think)
- Added (proper) support for Island Pets.

Please notify me of any remaining issues. 
It's hard to find them all on my own.

plugins.author: Critical_Impact
plugins.name: Allagan Tools
plugins.punchline: Get organized in FFXIV, easily locate/show where to sort items, plan your crafting, and search for mobs, duties, airships, and submarines!
plugins.description:
Allagan Tool's primary purpose is to keep track of items across your characters/retainers/free company. With it's filter system you'll never lose track of items or not know where they should be sorted.

While this is it's primary purpose, it has quite an exhaustive list of other features including:
	- Craft planning
	- Market board integration
	- Item highlighting in inventories when searching/sorting and picking ingredients for crafts
	- Item window that includes vendor and source information among other things
	- Duty/mob/airship/submarine windows that are fully searchable
	- A filtering system that lets you setup complex searches for specific items 
	- Tooltip integration that'll let you see where the items are on hover
plugins.changelog:
### Added
- Added a Locations column to the Mobs compendium, click a flag to link the spawn location in chat or right click it to teleport
- Added a "Hunt Mark?" column to the Mobs compendium
- When the Mobs compendium is grouped by zone, a Current Zone menu can open the tab for the zone you are in, or follow you as you change zones
### Fixed
- Map links printed to chat from the compendium were showing the wrong name

rawManifest.TestingChangelog:
**One of the last pre-releases before moving to a full stable release** 

**New Features**

- The 'Nearby Players' list is now sorted alphabetically by default.
- New configuration options have been added:
	* 'Show known players first': display friends, party members & other known players on the top of the list

**Improvements**

- The 'Nearby Players' list will now sort by distance when finding players nearby to you. In practice, this means that when you've set the 'max players shown' to lower than the current nearby players, the people closest to you will be shown first.

**Translation Updates**

- German translation updates

plugins.name: PartyPlanner
plugins.punchline: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client!
plugins.description: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client!
plugins.changelog:
v1.7.1.0

This is a major update and please check against your current settings after updating, as some settings have been renamed or removed.

- Add support for NPC dialogues.
- Add support for a few more actions/items (DeepDungeon, minions/mounts, Bozjan, etc.).
- Add lookup history window to show some statistics about your bilingual exploration.
- Add support for all FFXIV official languages (JEDF plus Chinese and Korean, WIP).

v1.7.2.0 ~ v1.7.6.0
- Fix NPC dialogue matching issue for alphabetic languages (English, French, German, etc.).
- Fix long tooltips going beyond the screen.
- Gaps before/after the divider line between the translated description and the native one are now configurable in pixels.
- Tooltip layout is computed more accurately for better alignment/less chance to break.
- Fix the issue where the config window still pops up when the NPC dialogue feature is disabled.

plugins.author: Blooym
plugins.name: GoodFriend
plugins.punchline: Improvements to the in-game friend system, including login and logout notifications for your friends, and more.
plugins.description:
Key Features:
- Receive notifications when friends using GoodFriend log in or out.
- Chat messages show how many of your friends are online when you log in.

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.
plugins.changelog: Fix improperly sized main UI

rawManifest.TestingChangelog:
_Hey all, your average plugin developer rewriting their entire plugin every few months here with some exciting news.. I've rewritten GoodFriend from scratch!_

**:warning: Please note that upon updating to the new version, your configuration will be completely wiped as it is no longer compatible. You will also be unable to send events or receive events with your friends using the older version.**

## What's changed?

A new modular design has been used when rewriting so that new functionality can be added in the future with less development work. All the existing functionality of the plugin has been re-implemented already so you shouldn't notice anything missing.

Thanks to this new design, you can now toggle each module on/off independently so that you only have the functionality that you actually want to have.

The interface has also been completely redesigned to clearly show each module as well as plugin-wide configuration options. At the very least, I think it looks better (I'm not a UI/UX designer)

### New Modules

- Login State Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list log in or log out with customizable filtering to only catch the notifications you want to see. (As this is the old functionality of the plugin this module has been enabled by default)

- World Change Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list change worlds using the world visit system while logged in with filtering to only see when people visit your own world (Disabled by default, still being improved as of now)

### Bug Fixes

- Too many to list here, but most of the fixes are related to connectivity problems.

Let me know what you think in either the `#plugin-testing` channel or the GoodFriend plugin thread! Thanks in advance to the plugin reviewers that have to review this as well.

[Happy pride month btw](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FxqJcqvXgAE65GU?format=jpg&name=large)

plugins.punchline: Tobii and Eyeware Eye and Opentrack tracker support for FFXIV
plugins.description: Developed by the ingenious Garlean engineer Tobiias, this revolutionary Magitek device empowers adventurers by enabling hands-free enemy targeting with unparalleled precision.
plugins.changelog:
# Version 1.4.0

A complete visual overhaul, plus market value estimates.

- Every window redesigned around one theme: dark glass panels, brass rules and crystal-blue highlights.
- Removed the Compact and Neon layouts. Classic is now the only view and received all of the design work.
- Settings moved from stacked collapsing headers to a sectioned window with a navigation rail.
- New: estimated market value of everything you loot, priced for your home world via Universalis. The running total is independent of how many items the list keeps and has its own reset button. Can be turned off in the settings.
- Statistics charts are now properly drawn, with hover tooltips, in place of the old text bars.
- Statistics are computed off the draw thread; large histories no longer freeze the game when the window opens.
- Fixed an O(n^2) pass over the whole history that stalled the game for seconds on large collections.
- The loot list highlights new drops, marks rarity on every row and sizes its columns to the content.
- The roll window is now a set of rarity-tinted cards with a countdown ring and a crown on the winner.
- New: release notes appear once after each update, and from Settings - About.
- The overlay now waits until your character has finished logging in before it appears.
- Loot parsing recognises "sprig of".
- Fixed a drawing error being able to leave ImGui's window stack unbalanced.

rawManifest.TestingChangelog:
It's been a while! There's way too much to put into a single changelog, since this was basically a *total* rewrite of XIVDeck. In no particular order:

- A revamped communication system means communication between the Stream Deck and the game is *much* faster.
    - Windows users get to use Named Pipes for communication, while Linux and macOS users get Unix Domain Sockets.
    - The websocket server is still available (and will remain so), but is no longer preferred for use.
- The Stream Deck Plugin now can render hotbar slots far more faithfully to the game.
    - Sub-icons, costs, ***and cooldowns*** are now rendered on buttons that support them!
    - The in-game hotbar watcher will now only track visible hotbar slots, improving overall performance.
- The Stream Deck plugin has been ported to NodeJS, which should provide some performance boosts as well.
- New plugin internals means certain features should be much easier to add in the future.
- Linux is now finally officially supported via [OpenDeck](https://github.com/nekename/OpenDeck)!
- A new process detection engine should detect FFXIV much more reliably now across all operating systems.
- Multiboxing is now properly supported, with your Stream Deck buttons following your last-focused game client. 
  - The ability to "pin" a button to use a specific game client will be coming in a future update.
- **[DEPRECATION]** While never officially supported, control of XIVDeck over the network is no longer available. This may be readded in a later update, but for now it's just not possible.

It's very important to note that this is a pre-release change, and this new version of XIVDeck is considered beta. If you need things to work, I strongly suggest you wait for 0.5.1 or later. **Since the XIVDeck protocol has been remade, old clients will not be able to connect.** 

## Testing Notes

It's been a _really_ long time since I last had testing notes. So:

* Test everything! Major rewrites mean that things have changed, and there's plenty of room for bugs.
* Let me know if your buttons lose configuration or don't work quite right after the update. Please bring logs for your reports.
* I'm also particularly interested in performance, and if everything still feels better to navigate.

Full release notes and downloads are available [on the plugin GitHub](https://github.com/KazWolfe/XIVDeck/releases/tag/v0.5.0).

plugins.changelog:
# Version 1.4.0

A complete visual overhaul, plus market value estimates.

- Every window redesigned around one theme: dark glass panels, brass rules and crystal-blue highlights.
- Removed the Compact and Neon layouts. Classic is now the only view and received all of the design work.
- Settings moved from stacked collapsing headers to a sectioned window with a navigation rail.
- New: estimated market value of everything you loot, priced for your home world via Universalis. The running total is independent of how many items the list keeps and has its own reset button. Can be turned off in the settings.
- Statistics charts are now properly drawn, with hover tooltips, in place of the old text bars.
- Statistics are computed off the draw thread; large histories no longer freeze the game when the window opens.
- Fixed an O(n^2) pass over the whole history that stalled the game for seconds on large collections.
- The loot list highlights new drops, marks rarity on every row and sizes its columns to the content.
- The roll window is now a set of rarity-tinted cards with a countdown ring and a crown on the winner.
- New: release notes appear once after each update, and from Settings - About.
- The overlay now waits until your character has finished logging in before it appears.
- Loot parsing recognises "sprig of".
- Fixed a drawing error being able to leave ImGui's window stack unbalanced.

plugins.author: darkarchon
plugins.name: XIVJitterFix
plugins.punchline: Fixes SquareEnix' botched antialiasing implementation
plugins.description:
With the release of 7.0 SquareEnix has implemented several temporal antialiasing solutions. However they all have a severe bug that affects image quality significantly.
This plugin will restore using jitter when talking to NPCs or in cutscenes and gpose. Jitter (not noticeable micromovements of the camera) is necessary for temporal antialiasing solutions (DLSS, DLAA, TSCMAA+jitter) to work properly.
For some reason, SquareEnix decided we don't need jitter during the time where the game benefits from using it the most.

rawManifest.Changelog:
v1.7.1.0

This is a major update and please check against your current settings after updating, as some settings have been renamed or removed.

- Add support for NPC dialogues.
- Add support for a few more actions/items (DeepDungeon, minions/mounts, Bozjan, etc.).
- Add lookup history window to show some statistics about your bilingual exploration.
- Add support for all FFXIV official languages (JEDF plus Chinese and Korean, WIP).

v1.7.2.0 ~ v1.7.6.0
- Fix NPC dialogue matching issue for alphabetic languages (English, French, German, etc.).
- Fix long tooltips going beyond the screen.
- Gaps before/after the divider line between the translated description and the native one are now configurable in pixels.
- Tooltip layout is computed more accurately for better alignment/less chance to break.
- Fix the issue where the config window still pops up when the NPC dialogue feature is disabled.

plugins.author: tesu
plugins.name: Penny Pincher
plugins.punchline: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices
plugins.description:
Plugin for simplifying "pennying" (undercutting current lowest offer by 1).

The usual workflow for this is the following:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Take a mental note of what the current lowest offer is
4. Subtract one from it
5. Close the current listings window
6. Update your item's price with the number you noted
7. Confirm your new price

This plugin eliminates the mental notekeeping steps in the middle by automatically copying the number you want onto your clipboard when you open the current listings window.  

Therefore, your new workflow becomes this:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Close the current listings window
4. Paste the undercut value in
5. Confirm your new price

This both speeds up the process and reduces room for error from typos.
plugins.changelog: API 15

plugins.punchline: Parses Buffs to help understand what your party is doing.
plugins.description: Adds Text and Icons next to the party list describing active buffs. Still missing some jobs - See github for progress. Please note the overlay goes to the left of your party list.
plugins.changelog:
First stable release.

Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > Some languages may be partially broken in translation.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

plugins.author: Berna

plugins.punchline:
[REQUIRES TF2 INSTALLED FOR MOST FEATURES] The Mann Brothers just found a deposit of gravel in Eorzea
and hired YOU, Mercenary of Light, to help them FIGHT for it.
plugins.description:
* Show a Win Panel (with sounds!) when you clear or get wiped in a duty.
* Show a TF2-style timer while in a duty.
* Enable the "Voice Lines" module (via /tfconfig) to have voice lines play when certain conditions are met. What conditions, you ask? It's a surprise! (Unless you uncheck the "Surprise me!" box.)
* More features maybe soon?

Note: This plugin uses files from a local Team Fortress 2 installation.
It'll search for the game's installation folder in all configured Steam Library Folders automatically.

Without a TF2 install, the Timer and Win Panel will work with FF XIV fonts, and no voice line will work.

plugins.description:
## Modes
### Venue:
- Concise display of all concurrent players in a list-based format
- Supports multiple sorting types (min, max, nearest to)
- Highlight numbers based on regex matching

### DeathRoll:
- Supports multiple players
- Automatic checks to prevent number skipping

### Tournament (1v1 DeathRoll):
- Automatic bracket generation with byes to fill uneven
- Forfeit functionality if a player needs to leave

### Blackjack:
- Automatic reward calculation based on common rules
- Simplistic, or visual view of cards in play
- Automatic or manual player-based draw for cards

### Extra Features:
- Block or prevent players from partaking in any game
- Accept only /random or /dice commands

## Games
### Tic-Tac-Toe
- Play against your friends, or AI
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5

### Minesweeper
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 8x8, 9x9, 16x16, 18x30
- Custom Games (planned)

More features are planned, following user feedback.
plugins.changelog:
Fixed `/dice` roll detection

Thanks to Zunetrix on Discord for submitting and sending over an updated sig

plugins.author: perchbird
plugins.name: PrefPro
plugins.punchline: Changes in-game dialogue to reference your desired gender and name.
plugins.description:
Your character is personal, so you should be able to have NPCs refer to them
the way that you want. With PrefPro, you can control which text option
will appear when an NPC uses dialogue meant for a specific in-game gender.
This allows you to use a female player model and be referred to as male, and
vice versa. In addition, there are a few name customization options - if you
want to only be referred to by your last name, so be it.
Note: This plugin currently will not swap voiced cutscene dialogue.
plugins.changelog: - **Fixed:** A crash due to changes to the Master's Bestiary in Patch 7.58.

plugins.author: Caraxi
plugins.name: Macro Chain
plugins.punchline: Run multiple macros one after the other.
plugins.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro' but this command cannot be used while macros are running.

plugins.name: Umbra XIV
plugins.punchline: Adds fully customizable toolbars and 3D world markers to the game.
plugins.description: Consolidates common UI elements and actions into a single uniform interface in the form of a set of highly customizable toolbars.
plugins.changelog:
# Umbra 3.1.18

## Fixes & Improvements

- Adds setting "Use windows draw list" to Toolbar Settings. By enabling it, other plugins may draw on top of Umbra Toolbars. This adds support for plugins that manage window layers. e.g. Gaolbreak (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Adds setting to auto-hide Auxiliary Toolbars (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Adds placeholders for Free Company name and tag (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Enables Occult Survey Point Markers for North Horn (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Added support for Fortune Carrot markers in North Horn (By [GayPotatoEmma](https://github.com/GayPotatoEmma)).
- Added support for Pot Coffer markers in North Horn (By [GayPotatoEmma](https://github.com/GayPotatoEmma)).
- Overhauled the Phantom Jobs widget with new display options. Users who prefer the old layout can easily swap back to it in the Widget Settings (By [GayPotatoEmma](https://github.com/GayPotatoEmma)).
- Fixes Dynamic Menu placeholders not being updated (By [Bloodsoul](https://github.com/Bloodsoul)).
- Fixes possible Access Violation while accessing equipments (By [LTS-FFXIV](https://github.com/LTS-FFXIV)).

plugins.changelog:
# Version 1.4.0

A complete visual overhaul, plus market value estimates.

- Every window redesigned around one theme: dark glass panels, brass rules and crystal-blue highlights.
- Removed the Compact and Neon layouts. Classic is now the only view and received all of the design work.
- Settings moved from stacked collapsing headers to a sectioned window with a navigation rail.
- New: estimated market value of everything you loot, priced for your home world via Universalis. The running total is independent of how many items the list keeps and has its own reset button. Can be turned off in the settings.
- Statistics charts are now properly drawn, with hover tooltips, in place of the old text bars.
- Statistics are computed off the draw thread; large histories no longer freeze the game when the window opens.
- Fixed an O(n^2) pass over the whole history that stalled the game for seconds on large collections.
- The loot list highlights new drops, marks rarity on every row and sizes its columns to the content.
- The roll window is now a set of rarity-tinted cards with a countdown ring and a crown on the winner.
- New: release notes appear once after each update, and from Settings - About.
- The overlay now waits until your character has finished logging in before it appears.
- Loot parsing recognises "sprig of".
- Fixed a drawing error being able to leave ImGui's window stack unbalanced.

plugins.author: Kliff!!
plugins.name: Shanbells
plugins.punchline: Bringing Shananigans to Eorzea
plugins.description: Replaces the word 'Gil' with 'Shanbells' (or something else entirely!) in the Currency window and Tooltips.
plugins.changelog:
# Version 1.4.0

A complete visual overhaul, plus market value estimates.

- Every window redesigned around one theme: dark glass panels, brass rules and crystal-blue highlights.
- Removed the Compact and Neon layouts. Classic is now the only view and received all of the design work.
- Settings moved from stacked collapsing headers to a sectioned window with a navigation rail.
- New: estimated market value of everything you loot, priced for your home world via Universalis. The running total is independent of how many items the list keeps and has its own reset button. Can be turned off in the settings.
- Statistics charts are now properly drawn, with hover tooltips, in place of the old text bars.
- Statistics are computed off the draw thread; large histories no longer freeze the game when the window opens.
- Fixed an O(n^2) pass over the whole history that stalled the game for seconds on large collections.
- The loot list highlights new drops, marks rarity on every row and sizes its columns to the content.
- The roll window is now a set of rarity-tinted cards with a countdown ring and a crown on the winner.
- New: release notes appear once after each update, and from Settings - About.
- The overlay now waits until your character has finished logging in before it appears.
- Loot parsing recognises "sprig of".
- Fixed a drawing error being able to leave ImGui's window stack unbalanced.

plugins.author: smileyhead
plugins.name: Sticky Focus Target
plugins.punchline: Like /focustarget, but with no overrides.
plugins.description:
(PvE-only.) Adds the /stickyfocustarget command, which focuses your current
target, as long as you do not already have a focus target set.
  
Have you ever felt focusing was under-utilised? Wanted to use it without a
dedicated keybind? Do you not even know what focus targeting is?
You've come to the right place.
  
You can add this command to your Attack Nearest macro and ensure that the
first enemy you target will also become focused, and stay that way, until it dies.
With this, you can focus enemies without having to consciously press a keybind,
and ensure that, for instance, when a focused boss spawns an add and you target it,
the boss' focus will NOT get overriden.

This plugin does not change the behaviour of the stock /focustarget command,
and must be triggered either manually or by adding it to a macro.
Placeholders are supported.
plugins.changelog:
# What's New?
- Brought Compact and Portrait layouts to Native UI.
- Added tha ability to cycle between ImGui and Native UI in Settings.

(Native UI is toggled by default for new installs. If you have a reason to want ImGui as a default instead, let me know on Discord)

plugins.author: GitHixy
plugins.name: LootView
plugins.punchline: See every item you and your party pick up, as it drops.
plugins.description:
LootView is a live loot tracker for you and your party, with a permanent history and statistics behind it.

WHAT YOU GET

Works with every game language: English, Japanese, German and French.

- Live overlay listing every drop with its icon, rarity, quantity, who received it and how long ago.
- Estimated market value of your haul, priced for your home world through Universalis.
- Currency drawer beside the overlay with every currency you hold, its cap and the weekly tomestone limit.
- A banner on screen when another player commends you.
- Need/Greed panel that appears while rolls are open: time left on every item, each Need, Greed and Pass, who is still deciding, and the winner. Roll Need, Greed or Pass right from the panel, with the game's own loot window kept out of the way.
- Collectibles you already have (minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards, emotes, hairstyles, portrait frames) are marked on their icon.
- Detailed item tooltips with item level, jobs, stats, bonuses, materia slots and market price.
- Loot tables for dungeons, trials and raids - the duty you are in, or any duty you search for.
- Searchable history you can filter by item name, rarity, zone, high quality and owner.
- Statistics: rarity breakdown, top zones, daily and hourly activity, play streaks and period-over-period comparisons.
- Duty tracker recording your runs, clear times, items per run and personal bests.
- Export to JSON or CSV whenever you want.

GETTING STARTED

Type /lv to open the tracker and /lv config for settings. You can also open it from the server info bar.
Right-click any item to try it on, look it up, copy its name or blacklist it.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PRIVACY

Your history is stored locally in your Dalamud configuration folder and is never uploaded. Market prices are looked up from universalis.app and loot tables from garlandtools.org; both requests send only an item or duty ID. Price lookups can be turned off in the settings.
plugins.changelog:
# Version 1.6.5

- Jar on its own: the loot jar can now stay on screen by itself, just the glass with no frame. Move it, resize it from its edges and lock it in place from Settings > General. It fades back while nothing is happening and comes forward when something drops in.
- The loot jar now holds exactly what the loot list shows: clearing the list pours it out, and drops that leave the list leave the jar too.
- Ticker: Ctrl+click a drop, or pick Dismiss from its right-click menu, to clear it early. A broom button next to the ticker's controls clears every drop at once.

plugins.author: rail
plugins.name: Aetherial Arena
plugins.punchline: Find and collect creatures to fight.
plugins.description: A collectable battling mini game
plugins.changelog:
First stable release.

Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > Some languages may be partially broken in translation.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

- Cross-character sharing configurations.
- Crossworld markers.
- Add personal notes for context.

Think of it as dropping a flag on the map but persistent.

rawManifest.TestingChangelog:
A clean interface that shows the user's gearsets in a scrollable table, where gearsets can be rearranged by drag and drop. Once the user is happy with the order of their gearsets, they can click apply to change them in game. The sorter has two methods: insert and swap. Also has a window to preview the gearset. Shows the name of the gearsets, item level, items in gearset and attached materia. plugins.description: Adds a command to swap glamours without needing to specify which gearset. Why this isn't in the base game, I don't know. Usage: /cgs <glamNumber>
plugins.changelog:
First stable release.

Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > Some languages may be partially broken in translation.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

plugins.name: RealTorch
plugins.punchline: Set the world alight!
plugins.description: Makes the torch accessory put out light.
plugins.changelog:
First stable release.

Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > Some languages may be partially broken in translation.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

plugins.author: Aireil
plugins.name: InputFlow
plugins.punchline: Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing behaviors.
plugins.description:
Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts. Works in all game text inputs: chat, macros, search, etc.

Supported shortcuts:
    - Ctrl + Left/Right: Jump between words
    - Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right: Select word by word
    - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete: Delete words
    - Ctrl + Insert: Copy
    - Shift + Insert: Paste
    - Shift + Delete: Cut

Changes:
    - Pressing Left/Right with the cursor at the start/end of an input properly clears the selection instead of doing nothing.
    - Clearing an active selection with Left/Right moves the cursor to the beginning/end of the selection.

Setting:
    - Configurable word boundary: Choose whether Ctrl + Right jumps to word ends (Discord, IDEs) or word starts (Windows, Notepad++, ImGui).
plugins.changelog: - Added my cat's ko-fi link

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words

- Grand Company Seal Exchange: Quartermasters of Grand Companies.

plugins.author: Juan Medina
plugins.name: It's Up
plugins.punchline: Yes. Still up. Press it.
plugins.description:
Doing your rotation is hard enough without having to stare at your hotbars. This plugin helps you know exactly when an ability you actually care about is back up.

We don't want to clutter your screen with a massive status board. This won't show you everything that's currently available—instead, it stays completely empty until you use an ability in combat. Once you spend it and it comes off cooldown, the icon pops up to remind you. Press it, and it's gone again.

Because it only reminds you about things you've already used, it won't spam your screen before a pull. And for abilities with charges, it only pings when you go from 0 to 1—if you're sitting on a charge, it stays out of your way since you can already press it.

It's perfect for those key rotational abilities you really don't want to drift. You can also configure each ability so the reminder stays on screen until you press it, or quietly disappears after a few seconds.
plugins.changelog:
- Display upgraded action names and icons based on character level.
- Fix handling of follow-up abilities versus upgraded actions.
- Improve hotbar keybind detection for upgraded abilities.

plugins.changelog:
First stable release.

Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? plugins.author: Juan Medina
plugins.name: Gubal
plugins.punchline: Open web pages, wikis, and Lodestone articles in your browser directly from your chat bar.
plugins.description:
Inspired by the /wiki command from Guild Wars 2, Gubal lets you open web pages in your browser straight from the in-game chat bar. Named after the Great Gubal Library, just type a slash command followed by what you're looking for to jump directly to specific guides, item pages, and articles in your default browser.
            
            Commands and Examples:
            
            /wiki [query] - Search the FFXIV Console Games Wiki (opens in browser):
            - /wiki great gubal library (opens The Great Gubal Library dungeon guide)
            - /wiki sightseeing log (opens the Sightseeing Log guide)
            - /wiki relic weapons (opens the Relic Weapon progression guide)
            - /wiki blue mage spells (opens the Blue Mage spell list)
            
            /lodestone [query] - Search the official Lodestone (opens in browser):
            - /lodestone patch 7.56 (opens the Patch 7.56 notes directly)
            - /lodestone maintenance (opens latest server maintenance notices)
            - /lodestone eorzea database excalibur (opens official item details)
            - /lodestone community finder (opens the Community Finder)
            
            /gubal - Open the configuration window to add, edit, or customize search commands with the {text} placeholder.

Keybinds Plus is a plugin that allows you to bind _almost_ any key on your keyboard to either a XIV keybind or a supported Dalamud plugin.

Keybinds Plus allows you to bind any key, including those that are not supported by the game (F13-F24) to almost any game function (Shortcuts, Chat, Targeting, Hotbars) as well as any plugin that implements KeybindsPlus' IPC. You can also bind a key to a custom command (like `/wlmark`) or macro just like how the game does.

Supported Keybinds:
- Custom Macros and Commands
- Supported Plugins
- Targeting*
- Shortcuts
- Chat*
- Hotbars

  > \* - Some features may be grayed out due to complexities or unavailability. Not all base game keybinds are in KeybindsPlus but may appear as updates progress.

This plugin is a early state and quite ambitious of me to do from prior plugins I've made. Why did I decide to write this? Simply put I wanted to use my Razer Miyabi keyboard macros and originally wanted to use F13 but game said no so I said `Fine. I'll do it myself.`  Also, past conversations. Thanks Miyabi :)

## AI Declaration
Code Usage: Assist
> Claude/Gemini was used only to inquire about what ClientStructs to use given my prior research to reading said ClientStructs aside from the people who suggested/pointed me to the right CS in #plugin-dev and reading code from other plugins that were a basis on Better Keybinds like Vanilla Plus, MouseLock, Chat 2, a bit of DelvUI and Better Targeting System in a way I could best understand it. All other code was written by me, borrowed from some Github searching for things and Google-fu.

Image Usage: None

plugins.name: Things To Do In Eorzea
plugins.punchline: Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!
plugins.description:
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.

# What's New?
- Fixed a bug for items where the wrong item ID got displayed.

plugins.description:
This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

Currently detects:
	- Aether Currents
	- Eureka Elementals (by apetih)
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
	- Gathering Points
	- [Experimental] Island Sanctuary Gathering Objects and Animals
	- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects 

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost

plugins.changelog:
This is a pretty big update. The directory now includes community events, Party Finder venue ads, notifications, and quite a few changes to how venues are displayed and filtered.

- Added a new Events tab. It shows FFXIV community events posted on Partake for the next two weeks, with filters for time, age rating, tags and location. You can also mark events with "I'm going" if you plan to attend.
- Party Finder venue ads collected by xivpf.com can now appear alongside events, as well as directly on the matching venue's page.
- Venues don't necessarily have to be listed on FFXIV Venues anymore. If a venue has an event on Partake or is currently advertising in Party Finder, it can still appear in the directory.
- Venue pages now show their upcoming events and any Party Finder ads that are currently active.
- Added optional notifications for favorite venues and events. The plugin can notify you when a favorite venue opens, when an event at a favorite venue starts, or 15 minutes before an event you've marked as going to. These notifications still work while the directory window is closed.
- Added "My data center" filtering. It follows the data center your current character is actually on, including after Data Center Travel. Location filters are remembered separately for each character.
- If you're standing on the plot of a listed venue, or you're already inside it, the top bar now tells you which venue you're at and gives you a quick way to mark it as visited.
- You can now hide venues you're not interested in. There's an undo option in the top bar, and hidden venues can always be found again with the Hidden filter.
- Venue descriptions now keep much more of their original formatting, including headings, bold and italic text, lists, links and images. Animated GIF, WebP and APNG images are supported too. Images in descriptions are only loaded over HTTPS and can be turned off in settings.
- Banners and images can optionally be enlarged by hovering over them. This is disabled by default.
- Locations outside the housing districts can now be opened on the in-game map.
- Settings have been moved into their own window and split into separate pages for appearance, images, events and notifications. There's also an About page with the changelog. You can use the directory's own theme or your Dalamud theme, change the UI size, and choose between a 12- or 24-hour clock.
- Schedule handling has been reworked. The directory now tries to show each venue's next actual opening in your local timezone instead of just displaying the raw weekly schedule. Monthly schedules, breaks, one-off openings and active venue notices are supported, and openings more than a week away show the date as well.
- Venue names and descriptions now show many more symbols and stylized letters; characters the game can't draw are replaced with plain letters instead of showing as boxes.
- Added a clearer error message for cases where FFXIV Venues refuses requests from your network or region.

plugins.author: The Redheaded Witch & WillWolf76
plugins.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugins.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!
plugins.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.

plugins.author: AEBus
plugins.name: FFXIV Venues Directory
plugins.punchline: Browse FFXIV roleplay venues in-game with rich filters and schedules.
plugins.description: Discover open FFXIV venues by region, data center, world, tags, and schedule. View detailed venue cards with addresses, banners, and external links directly in-game.
plugins.changelog:
This is a pretty big update. The directory now includes community events, Party Finder venue ads, notifications, and quite a few changes to how venues are displayed and filtered.

- Added a new Events tab. It shows FFXIV community events posted on Partake for the next two weeks, with filters for time, age rating, tags and location. You can also mark events with "I'm going" if you plan to attend.
- Party Finder venue ads collected by xivpf.com can now appear alongside events, as well as directly on the matching venue's page.
- Venues don't necessarily have to be listed on FFXIV Venues anymore. If a venue has an event on Partake or is currently advertising in Party Finder, it can still appear in the directory.
- Venue pages now show their upcoming events and any Party Finder ads that are currently active.
- Added optional notifications for favorite venues and events. The plugin can notify you when a favorite venue opens, when an event at a favorite venue starts, or 15 minutes before an event you've marked as going to. These notifications still work while the directory window is closed.
- Added "My data center" filtering. It follows the data center your current character is actually on, including after Data Center Travel. Location filters are remembered separately for each character.
- If you're standing on the plot of a listed venue, or you're already inside it, the top bar now tells you which venue you're at and gives you a quick way to mark it as visited.
- You can now hide venues you're not interested in. There's an undo option in the top bar, and hidden venues can always be found again with the Hidden filter.
- Venue descriptions now keep much more of their original formatting, including headings, bold and italic text, lists, links and images. Animated GIF, WebP and APNG images are supported too. Images in descriptions are only loaded over HTTPS and can be turned off in settings.
- Banners and images can optionally be enlarged by hovering over them. This is disabled by default.
- Locations outside the housing districts can now be opened on the in-game map.
- Settings have been moved into their own window and split into separate pages for appearance, images, events and notifications. There's also an About page with the changelog. You can use the directory's own theme or your Dalamud theme, change the UI size, and choose between a 12- or 24-hour clock.
- Schedule handling has been reworked. The directory now tries to show each venue's next actual opening in your local timezone instead of just displaying the raw weekly schedule. Monthly schedules, breaks, one-off openings and active venue notices are supported, and openings more than a week away show the date as well.
- Venue names and descriptions now show many more symbols and stylized letters; characters the game can't draw are replaced with plain letters instead of showing as boxes.
- Added a clearer error message for cases where FFXIV Venues refuses requests from your network or region.

plugins.author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
plugins.name: EchoXIV
plugins.punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.
plugins.description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple translation engines (Google, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores de traducción (Google, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.

rawManifest.Changelog: Initial Release
rawManifest.TestingChangelog:
v1.0.2.1:
- Added Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LibreTranslate, and Yandex translation engines.
- Added configurable translation instances with primary engine selection, ordered fallback, and recovery probing.
- Added per-instance model, API key, temperature, and response token limit settings.
- Added single-request AI romanization with native and Latin-script output in structured JSON.
- Improved romanization support for Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian.
- Improved translated-chat display for native text, Latin-script text, original messages, and tooltips.
- Unified translation logs with the selected engine, target language, elapsed time, and romanization.
- Added local language detection to skip translation when messages already match the configured target language.
- Added configurable language-detection confidence from 70% to 100%, with an 85% default.
- Added independent translated-window message limits and size-based persistent chat history.
- Added history search and filtering, and made Clear remove only messages currently displayed.
- Added direct settings access from the translated-chat window and an option to control /tl chat status messages.
- Centralized engine, instance, priority, and failover management in the Engines tab.

plugins.author: GitHixy
plugins.name: HitSpark
plugins.punchline: Replace the game's combat numbers with animated, styleable fly text.
plugins.description:
HitSpark replaces Final Fantasy XIV's combat text with its own renderer: better fonts, tuned motion and real impact on critical hits.

WHAT YOU GET

- Every kind of combat text redrawn: damage dealt and taken, healing, misses and evades, status effects, experience, crafting and loot.
- Eight built-in presets, each a complete look: Classic+, Heroic, Tally, Onslaught, Elemental, Grim, Minimal and Retro.
- Real motion: arcs, fountains, rising and falling paths, scrolling columns, and punch, shake, flash, sparks and trails on crits.
- Multi-hits and damage over time that roll up into one number, with DoT ticks in their own colour.
- Other players' numbers shown smaller, or hidden, for your party and for everyone else, with a distance limit.
- Rear and flank hints for positionals, and an option to let numbers pass under the game's UI.
- A style editor for every category with a live preview, and presets you can share as a short code.

GETTING STARTED

Type /hitspark (or /hs) to open the settings and pick a preset. /hitspark test plays sample numbers on you and your target, even out of combat.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you.

PLAYS BY THE RULES

HitSpark is purely cosmetic: it redraws text the game already shows you and follows the game's own flying text and pop-up text options. The only extra is the optional positional hint, worked out from where you're standing. If a game update breaks it, the game's own numbers come back on their own. Settings and presets are stored locally and nothing is ever sent anywhere.
plugins.changelog:
- Positionals: on Monk, Dragoon, Ninja, Samurai, Reaper and Viper, a small "Rear" or "Flank" now shows above your damage when you land a positional, and "Rear missed" or "Flank missed" when you don't. They have their own styles in every preset, so you can restyle or hide them.
- New "Below game UI" option: numbers slide under your hotbars, party list, chat and the other game windows instead of covering them, while your target's bars and your own HP/MP stay on top. Off by default.
- New "Max distance" option: numbers from other people more than 50 yalms away, like a FATE across the map, are no longer shown. You can change the distance or turn the limit off.
- Fixed numbers (DoT ticks above all) showing during cutscenes in the middle of a duty.

plugins.author: GitHixy
plugins.name: FateLimit
plugins.punchline: See the edge of every FATE, and know before you step out of it.
plugins.description:
FateLimit draws the border of FATE areas right in the world, so you always know where the fight ends and never lose your level sync by wandering out.

WHAT YOU GET

- Five border styles made to sit in Eorzea: Aether ring, Barrier wall, Marching dashes, Crystal runes and FATE ember.
- Two ways to show them: always, or only when you get close to the edge of the FATE you're in.
- A warning colour that creeps in as you near the edge, an on-screen banner with the distance left and a marker on the closest point of the border.
- Borders that follow the ground over hills and slopes instead of floating through them.
- Colour, thickness, height, spacing, glow and animation for every style, with a live preview in the settings.

GETTING STARTED

Type /fatelimit (or /fl) to open the settings. /fatelimit test places a practice FATE around you so you can try every style without waiting for a real one.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PLAYS BY THE RULES

FateLimit is purely visual: it only reads where FATEs are, which the game already shows on your map, and draws over the screen. It never moves your character or sends anything to the game. Settings are stored locally and nothing is ever uploaded.
plugins.changelog:
# Version 0.1.0

- Five Border styles
- show borders all the time or only when getting closer to the limit
- Option to only show the border in the fate that you're currently in
- borders follow terrain

plugins.description: Create a temporary chats for you and your friends, that are working inside a duty or locked instances. Add how many people u want, and manage it from there!
plugins.changelog:
Plugin for creating a temporary chats for you and your friends, that are working inside a duty or locked instances. Add how many people u want, and manage it from there!

**Features**:
* Easy creating chat groups.
* Easy invite players to chat groups - even if they are in locked instance
* Chat groups are temporary - u can easily add and leave them with one click
* Messages are only client-side - that means they arent saved on backend.
* Allows u to configure - u can block invitations from others, or only when ure in duty

It's initial version 1.0.0
Source-code of backend is available via repository.
AI used only to generate GUI. Everything else is human-made.

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description: A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugins.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON
plugins.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugins.changelog: - Cosmic will only enable autohook if it needs to start a fishing mission, will not try and disable it.

plugins.author: Aida Enna
plugins.name: Macro Chain Redux
plugins.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).
plugins.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro
plugins.changelog: - Updated for patch 7.5

plugins.author: The Combat Reborn Team
plugins.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugins.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
plugins.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.author: NightmareXIV
plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

- Library updates
- Improvements to map effect tab

plugins.author: NiGuangOwO
plugins.name: DalamudMCP
plugins.punchline: 连接 AI 助手，辅助插件开发与调试 | AI-assisted plugin development & debugging.
plugins.description:
通过 MCP（模型上下文协议）连接 AI 助手与 FINAL FANTASY XIV，为 Dalamud 插件开发、运行时分析和游戏内验证提供工具。

读取角色、物品栏、游戏数据、界面文本与运行日志，检查插件和 IPC，并在授权后执行界面交互等操作。

安装后输入 /dalamudmcp 打开设置，并配置支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端。默认仅开放只读工具；修改游戏状态的工具需手动启用。仅支持 stdio 的客户端可使用配套桥接程序。

Connect AI agents to FINAL FANTASY XIV through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Dalamud plugin development, runtime analysis, and in-game validation.

Read character, inventory, game data, UI text, and runtime logs; inspect plugins and IPC; and perform UI interactions with explicit permission.

After installation, open settings with /dalamudmcp and configure an MCP-compatible AI client. Only read-only tools are enabled by default; tools that change game state must be enabled manually. A companion bridge is available for stdio-only clients.

读取角色、物品栏、游戏数据、界面文本与运行日志，检查插件和 IPC，并在授权后执行界面交互等操作。

安装后输入 /dalamudmcp 打开设置，并配置支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端。默认仅开放只读工具；修改游戏状态的工具需手动启用。仅支持 stdio 的客户端可使用配套桥接程序。

Connect AI agents to FINAL FANTASY XIV through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Dalamud plugin development, runtime analysis, and in-game validation.

Read character, inventory, game data, UI text, and runtime logs; inspect plugins and IPC; and perform UI interactions with explicit permission.

After installation, open settings with /dalamudmcp and configure an MCP-compatible AI client. Only read-only tools are enabled by default; tools that change game state must be enabled manually. A companion bridge is available for stdio-only clients.

plugins.author: NightmareXIV
plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugins.changelog:
- Library updates
- Improvements to map effect tab

plugins.author: Anna
plugins.name: Heliosphere
plugins.punchline: An efficient mod manager and platform that integrates directly with Penumbra.
plugins.description:
Heliosphere is a mod manager and platform designed to work directly with
Penumbra. It enables efficient downloads and fast installs to let you get back
to the fun part of mods: using them.

Heliosphere supports:
- Direct install to Penumbra
- Compressed and deduplicated (read: small) downloads
- Automatic updates (optional)
- Version history
- Mod changelogs
- Pictures in Penumbra
- And more

Give Heliosphere a try, and see if you can't say goodbye to any old mod
platform you were using before.

plugins.description:

- Advanced actor posing 
	- While animating
	- Overlay and graphical posing modes
- Creation of up to 239 G-Pose actors
- Creation of custom lights
- Spawn and edit any visual object, Furniture or VFX in the game

- Make and paly animations with Vivacity. The animation Timeline
- Play XAT .xcp camera files
- Play/Blend animations of GPose actors
- Control Time/Weather in both the Overworld and GPose
- Change the active festivals and apply up to 8 at once
- Add/Remove Status Effects of GPose actors

plugins.author: Faye, Kage
plugins.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugins.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
plugins.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description:
A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.author: NightmareXIV
plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/plugins

plugins.author: Faye, Kage
plugins.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugins.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
plugins.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description:
A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.punchline: An efficient mod manager and platform that integrates directly with Penumbra.
plugins.description:
Heliosphere is a mod manager and platform designed to work directly with
Penumbra. It enables efficient downloads and fast installs to let you get back
to the fun part of mods: using them.

Heliosphere supports:
- Direct install to Penumbra
- Compressed and deduplicated (read: small) downloads
- Automatic updates (optional)
- Version history
- Mod changelogs
- Pictures in Penumbra
- And more

Give Heliosphere a try, and see if you can't say goodbye to any old mod
platform you were using before.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugins.changelog: - Cosmic will only enable autohook if it needs to start a fishing mission, will not try and disable it.

Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.

plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

plugins.changelog:
ec459fc: Update ARControl.csproj
f0ea323: Remove DiscardHelper integration
ea6de7c: Modernize codebase with C# 12 features

- Adopt primary constructors in VentureResolver, AutoRetainerReflection, and VentureListTab
  - Reduces boilerplate code by eliminating field declarations and assignments
  - Parameters are directly accessible throughout the class
- Standardize collection expressions using [] syntax
  - Replace 'new Dictionary<>()' with '[]' for cleaner initialization
  - Replace 'new List<>()' with '[]' for consistency
- Simplify LINQ queries by replacing .Where().Cast<>() with .OfType<>()
  - More efficient and cleaner null filtering
  - Removes unnecessary null-forgiving operators (!)
- Update array initializers to use collection expression syntax

These changes reduce code complexity while maintaining full compatibility with .NET 10 and C# 12.
1138beb: Switch to ECommons DalamudReflector

- Replace custom DalamudReflector implementation with ECommons.Reflection.DalamudReflector
- Simplify AutoRetainerReflection by removing IDisposable pattern (static method usage)
- Delete ARControl/Internal/DalamudReflector.cs (117 lines)
- Update .gitignore to exclude .claude/ directory
