plugins.author: mrbotic
plugins.name: AutoRezzer
plugins.punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
plugins.description:
Raises dead players around you, and accepts raises cast on you.

Requires Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch. Anyone in range who needs a raise gets one, Swiftcast first. In Occult Crescent it uses Occult Raise or Revive instead, which work on any job. It pauses your rotation only when a rez is genuinely about to happen, then puts it back exactly as it was. Four switches decide where it works: open world and FATEs, instanced duties, Eureka and Bozja, and the Crescent.

Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: AutoRezzer now stands down completely in PvP - Frontline, Crystalline Conflict, Rival Wings and the Wolves' Den. Nothing sweeps, nothing swaps your job, and nothing accepts anything until you leave. Nobody can be raised in PvP, so there was never anything to gain in there, but there was plenty to lose: Frontline lets you change class at the spawn point, and the spawn point is exactly where dead players pile up waiting to respawn, so the plugin saw a field of bodies, decided an instant raise was called for, and turned you into a Red Mage mid-match - taking the damage you had done and your series progress on the class you queued as with it. This is not a setting and will not become one; the card and the server bar both say so while it is holding, so a plugin that is switched on and deliberately doing nothing still looks switched on. The "Ready to rez" line under the job name is also gone, because the Active badge beside the name already said it. The line still appears when there is something to say: a level you are synced below, a Swiftcast still on cooldown, or a job with no raise at all.

plugins.author: Faye, Kage
plugins.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugins.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
plugins.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OhKannaDuh/plugins/refs/heads/master/manifest.json

plugins.author: mrbotic
plugins.name: Eureka Challenge Helper
plugins.punchline: Auto-tracks your weekly Eureka challenge log kills.
plugins.description:
Alpha.

Tracks the Eureka elemental challenge log while you play.

When you kill an enemy in Eureka that you get credit for, the plugin works out what it was - fire, ice, wind, earth, lightning or water aspected, a sprite, or an ashkin - and adds 1 to the matching counter, so your progress toward the weekly Elemental challenge log is always one banished glance away.

Every counter row also has a Track button. Switch it on and the plugin draws a line in the 3D view from your hitbox to every enemy that row would count, so you can find your ashkin or your fire aspected without having to target anything first. Element rows accept mobs up to two levels below you, sprites and ashkin must be your level or higher, exactly as the challenge log itself counts them.

Starting numbers: set them once in the window to match the current in-game log, use the +/- buttons, and hit the reset button when the week rolls over.

Enemy elements come from a bundled map of the four zones' enemies, and the aspect the game shows on a nameplate is picked up automatically. An enemy the plugin cannot place is not counted.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: First alpha release.

Every counter row also has a Track button. Switch it on and the plugin draws a line in the 3D view from your hitbox to every enemy that row would count, so you can find your ashkin or your fire aspected without having to target anything first. Element rows accept mobs up to two levels below you, sprites and ashkin must be your level or higher, exactly as the challenge log itself counts them.

Starting numbers: set them once in the window to match the current in-game log, use the +/- buttons, and hit the reset button when the week rolls over.

Enemy elements come from a bundled map of the four zones' enemies, and the aspect the game shows on a nameplate is picked up automatically. An enemy the plugin cannot place is not counted.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
rawManifest.Punchline: Auto-tracks your weekly Eureka challenge log kills.

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description:
A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.author: mrbotic
plugins.name: Gearset Manager
plugins.punchline: One set per job, in your order. Plan it, then apply.
plugins.description:
Your gearsets as a grid of job icons: one main set per unlocked job (its highest item level set), battle jobs then crafters then gatherers, with ultimate and spare sets underneath, labelled like "GNB Â· i790" and "GNB (FRU) Â· i730". The job you are wearing sits at the top. Click a set to equip it.

Re-arrange is a plan: drag jobs into order, mark sets to delete, and choose which missing jobs get a set made or skipped. Nothing changes in game until you press Apply, which deletes, makes the missing sets (weapon, soul crystal, recommended gear, saved) and renumbers. Undo puts the old order back.

/gsm opens the window. /gsm sort makes missing sets (if switched on) and applies the order to the game's list.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: First release. A new look: your sets as a grid of job icons with their item levels, the job you are wearing at the top, and a Re-arrange mode that plans everything before Apply. Making a set now skips jobs you have no weapon for, and makes room in a full armoury chest by moving items that are in no gearset to your bags. DMU counts as an ultimate.

plugins.name: LeveHelper
plugins.punchline: A little helper for Levequests.
plugins.description:
A little helper to check which Levequests have been completed and which are missing.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Haselnussbomber/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
plugins.changelog:
- Added: You can now click on the group header in the Type filter to filter for either all Fieldcraft, Tradecraft or Grand Company Leves.
- Added: When GatherBuddy is installed, the Queue and Recipe Tree now display GatherBuddys tooltip on fish and spearfish, including info about the Bait, Time and Weather restrictions and the next uptimes.  
  - Please note that GatherBuddy uses the client language, not Dalamuds UI language like LeveHelper. It's out of my control.
- Fixed: Some gatherables did not show up in the Queue.

Regarding the Levemete filter

The game's database doesn't list which Levemete issues which Levequests and multiple old NPCs also rotate their Levequests when you complete one.

I used to scrape a wiki to gather this data, but two weeks ago, we added Levequest issuer tracking to the Tracky plugin and already have more entries than the wiki provided!

Some entries that I could confirm through another wiki are still missing, so manually added those back in for now.

If you'd like to help us, please install the Tracky plugin and enable uploads in its settings.

Thank you! :)

plugins.author: Aida Enna
plugins.name: Macro Chain Redux
plugins.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).
plugins.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aida-Enna/XIVPlugins/main/repo.json

plugins.name: PF Analysis
plugins.punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, a recruitment board with a Join button, party progression, and player lookups.
plugins.description:
Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; keep your listing alive on its own clock; browse and join the recruitment board for your data centre; and look up party members' progression and the clears they have posted.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: Japan's data centres are one Party Finder now, so the board is one JP pool - the Elemental, Gaia, Mana and Meteor tabs are gone, and every JP user sends the whole pool. The board and its coordinated join end on 10 November 2026, when the patch 7.58 maintenance begins: from then the game's own Party Finder shows every listing in your region, so the plugin's copy has nothing to add and stops being gathered or served. The Party Finder tab says why instead of showing an empty board. Presets, party progression, lookups and clears are unchanged.

Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

Plugin from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json

plugins.name: XIV Combo Expandedest
plugins.punchline: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button. Plus extras.
plugins.description:
This is an enhanced version of XIVCombo with a variety of new added features.
This is mutually exclusive with other XIVCombo versions, so make sure they do not conflict!

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Grammernatzi/MyDalamudPlugins/master/pluginmaster.json
plugins.changelog:
New features unlikely to be added until Evercold releases. Bug fixes will still happen, though.
    
    1.5.0.91: 
    * Removed Burst Strike/Fated Circle to Bloodfest as you now cannot overcap with Bloodfest.
    * Added Bloodfest to No Mercy.
    * Fixed a bug where Blizzard/Fire switcher did not work without Enochian unlocked.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added. Please look forward to it (happening right now).

plugins.changelog:
ec459fc: Update ARControl.csproj
f0ea323: Remove DiscardHelper integration
ea6de7c: Modernize codebase with C# 12 features

- Adopt primary constructors in VentureResolver, AutoRetainerReflection, and VentureListTab
  - Reduces boilerplate code by eliminating field declarations and assignments
  - Parameters are directly accessible throughout the class
- Standardize collection expressions using [] syntax
  - Replace 'new Dictionary<>()' with '[]' for cleaner initialization
  - Replace 'new List<>()' with '[]' for consistency
- Simplify LINQ queries by replacing .Where().Cast<>() with .OfType<>()
  - More efficient and cleaner null filtering
  - Removes unnecessary null-forgiving operators (!)
- Update array initializers to use collection expression syntax

These changes reduce code complexity while maintaining full compatibility with .NET 10 and C# 12.
1138beb: Switch to ECommons DalamudReflector

- Replace custom DalamudReflector implementation with ECommons.Reflection.DalamudReflector
- Simplify AutoRetainerReflection by removing IDisposable pattern (static method usage)
- Delete ARControl/Internal/DalamudReflector.cs (117 lines)
- Update .gitignore to exclude .claude/ directory

2c72047: bump version
4fbbb31: api14/net10
9d0aad1: Create ci.yaml

plugins.author: mrbotic
plugins.name: AutoRezzer
plugins.punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
plugins.description:
Raises dead players around you, and accepts raises cast on you.

Requires Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch. Anyone in range who needs a raise gets one, Swiftcast first. In Occult Crescent it uses Occult Raise or Revive instead, which work on any job. It pauses your rotation only when a rez is genuinely about to happen, then puts it back exactly as it was. Four switches decide where it works: open world and FATEs, instanced duties, Eureka and Bozja, and the Crescent.

Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: AutoRezzer now stands down completely in PvP - Frontline, Crystalline Conflict, Rival Wings and the Wolves' Den. Nothing sweeps, nothing swaps your job, and nothing accepts anything until you leave. Nobody can be raised in PvP, so there was never anything to gain in there, but there was plenty to lose: Frontline lets you change class at the spawn point, and the spawn point is exactly where dead players pile up waiting to respawn, so the plugin saw a field of bodies, decided an instant raise was called for, and turned you into a Red Mage mid-match - taking the damage you had done and your series progress on the class you queued as with it. This is not a setting and will not become one; the card and the server bar both say so while it is holding, so a plugin that is switched on and deliberately doing nothing still looks switched on. The "Ready to rez" line under the job name is also gone, because the Active badge beside the name already said it. The line still appears when there is something to say: a level you are synced below, a Swiftcast still on cooldown, or a job with no raise at all.

plugins.author: Faye, Kage
plugins.name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugins.punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
plugins.description:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OhKannaDuh/plugins/refs/heads/master/manifest.json

plugins.author: mrbotic
plugins.name: Eureka Challenge Helper
plugins.punchline: Auto-tracks your weekly Eureka challenge log kills.
plugins.description:
Alpha.

Tracks the Eureka elemental challenge log while you play.

When you kill an enemy in Eureka that you get credit for, the plugin works out what it was - fire, ice, wind, earth, lightning or water aspected, a sprite, or an ashkin - and adds 1 to the matching counter, so your progress toward the weekly Elemental challenge log is always one banished glance away.

Every counter row also has a Track button. Switch it on and the plugin draws a line in the 3D view from your hitbox to every enemy that row would count, so you can find your ashkin or your fire aspected without having to target anything first. Element rows accept mobs up to two levels below you, sprites and ashkin must be your level or higher, exactly as the challenge log itself counts them.

Starting numbers: set them once in the window to match the current in-game log, use the +/- buttons, and hit the reset button when the week rolls over.

Enemy elements come from a bundled map of the four zones' enemies, and the aspect the game shows on a nameplate is picked up automatically. An enemy the plugin cannot place is not counted.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: First alpha release.

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description:
A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/ice
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.punchline: One set per job, in your order. Plan it, then apply.
plugins.description:
Your gearsets as a grid of job icons: one main set per unlocked job (its highest item level set), battle jobs then crafters then gatherers, with ultimate and spare sets underneath, labelled like "GNB Â· i790" and "GNB (FRU) Â· i730". The job you are wearing sits at the top. Click a set to equip it.

Re-arrange is a plan: drag jobs into order, mark sets to delete, and choose which missing jobs get a set made or skipped. Nothing changes in game until you press Apply, which deletes, makes the missing sets (weapon, soul crystal, recommended gear, saved) and renumbers. Undo puts the old order back.

/gsm opens the window. /gsm sort makes missing sets (if switched on) and applies the order to the game's list.

Making a set now skips jobs you have no weapon for, and makes room in a full armoury chest by moving items that are in no gearset to your bags. DMU counts as an ultimate.

plugins.changelog:
- Added: You can now click on the group header in the Type filter to filter for either all Fieldcraft, Tradecraft or Grand Company Leves.
- Added: When GatherBuddy is installed, the Queue and Recipe Tree now display GatherBuddys tooltip on fish and spearfish, including info about the Bait, Time and Weather restrictions and the next uptimes.  
  - Please note that GatherBuddy uses the client language, not Dalamuds UI language like LeveHelper. It's out of my control.
- Fixed: Some gatherables did not show up in the Queue.

Regarding the Levemete filter

The game's database doesn't list which Levemete issues which Levequests and multiple old NPCs also rotate their Levequests when you complete one.

I used to scrape a wiki to gather this data, but two weeks ago, we added Levequest issuer tracking to the Tracky plugin and already have more entries than the wiki provided!

Some entries that I could confirm through another wiki are still missing, so manually added those back in for now.

If you'd like to help us, please install the Tracky plugin and enable uploads in its settings.

Thank you! :)

plugins.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).
plugins.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

The header frog no longer sits on the menu button at phone widths.

plugins.name: PF Analysis

plugins.description:
Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; keep your listing alive on its own clock; browse and join the recruitment board for your data centre; and look up party members' progression and the clears they have posted.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugins.changelog: Japan's data centres are one Party Finder now, so the board is one JP pool - the Elemental, Gaia, Mana and Meteor tabs are gone, and every JP user sends the whole pool. The board and its coordinated join end on 10 November 2026, when the patch 7.58 maintenance begins: from then the game's own Party Finder shows every listing in your region, so the plugin's copy has nothing to add and stops being gathered or served. The Party Finder tab says why instead of showing an empty board. Presets, party progression, lookups and clears are unchanged.

Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

plugins.changelog:
New features unlikely to be added until Evercold releases. Bug fixes will still happen, though.
    
    1.5.0.91: 
    * Removed Burst Strike/Fated Circle to Bloodfest as you now cannot overcap with Bloodfest.
    * Added Bloodfest to No Mercy.
    * Fixed a bug where Blizzard/Fire switcher did not work without Enochian unlocked.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.

plugins.author: NightmareXIV
plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugins.changelog:
- Library updates
- Improvements to map effect tab

plugins.author: Aida Enna
plugins.name: Macro Chain Redux
plugins.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).
plugins.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

plugins.author: Haselnussbomber
plugins.name: LeveHelper
plugins.punchline: A little helper for Levequests.
plugins.description: A little helper to check which Levequests have been completed and which are missing.
plugins.changelog:
- Added: You can now click on the group header in the Type filter to filter for either all Fieldcraft, Tradecraft or Grand Company Leves.
- Added: When GatherBuddy is installed, the Queue and Recipe Tree now display GatherBuddys tooltip on fish and spearfish, including info about the Bait, Time and Weather restrictions and the next uptimes.  
  - Please note that GatherBuddy uses the client language, not Dalamuds UI language like LeveHelper. It's out of my control.
- Fixed: Some gatherables did not show up in the Queue.

Regarding the Levemete filter

The game's database doesn't list which Levemete issues which Levequests and multiple old NPCs also rotate their Levequests when you complete one.

I used to scrape a wiki to gather this data, but two weeks ago, we added Levequest issuer tracking to the Tracky plugin and already have more entries than the wiki provided!

Some entries that I could confirm through another wiki are still missing, so manually added those back in for now.

If you'd like to help us, please install the Tracky plugin and enable uploads in its settings.

Thank you! :)

plugins.author: The Combat Reborn Team
plugins.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugins.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
plugins.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.author: The Redheaded Witch, WillWolf76
plugins.name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugins.punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!
plugins.description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
plugins.changelog: Fixed some minor bugs.

plugins.author: Asteria Nocturna
plugins.name: Divination.AetheryteLinkInChat
plugins.punchline: Quick teleport for mob hunts and treasure hunts!
plugins.description: Display a teleport link to the nearest aetherite for the map link from the in-game chat. Type /alic to configure the plugin.
plugins.changelog:
e8f691d: Merge pull request #816 from SlashNephy/feat/alic-hunt-journeys

feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer Faloop's starting points for hunt spawn points
74b4951: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add exits missing from the game's map markers

The game's map markers do not describe the exit from Yanxia to the
Doman Enclave (The One River): the marker in Yanxia points to the
obsolete map 437, and the current map 463 has no marker back to Yanxia.
So routes through the Doman Enclave were never considered, which is the
Yanxia example in #656.

- Add MapConnections for such exits, starting with Yanxia <-> the Doman
  Enclave. Comparing Faloop's boundary starting points with the game's
  map markers found no other missing exit
- Consider them in the route calculation as ConnectionTeleportPath,
  without counting the distance inside the connected map, as where the
  exit leads to is not known
- Show them like zone boundaries, and stop the Lifestream teleport there

Refs #656

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
a3c0a1f: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer Faloop's starting points for hunt spawn points

Straight-line distance on the map ignores terrain, height and walls, so
the nearest aetheryte is often not the best one to start from.

Faloop's zone data has the spawn points of hunt marks, each with a
journeyPoiId that points to the aetheryte or zone boundary to start
from. Embed them (generated by Scripts/generate_hunt_journeys.py) and,
when a map link is at a known spawn point, only consider the routes that
enter the map at its starting point. Otherwise, fall back to the
straight-line distance as before.

Refs #656

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
97ddbb9: Merge pull request #815 from SlashNephy/fix/alic-detect-world

fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer the world name after the cross world icon
e5d9e91: fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer the world name after the cross world icon

DetectWorld picked the first public world in World sheet order whose
name appeared anywhere in the message. Mob names such as Odin and
Behemoth are also world names, so "Odin <map link> <CrossWorld>Cerberus"
resolved to Odin (row 66) instead of Cerberus (row 80), while
"Odin ... Omega" happened to work because Omega is row 39. The map link
trimming only removes text from the link marker (U+E0BB), so the mob
name before the link was kept.

- Prefer the world name right after the cross world icon, or the cross
  world character typed as text
- Otherwise use the world name that appears last in the message

Close #661

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
6ae42a0: Merge pull request #814 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-login-failure

fix(FaloopIntegration): report rejected logins instead of retrying
7900863: fix(FaloopIntegration): report rejected logins instead of retrying

Faloop responds to a login with wrong credentials with 400 and
{"success":false,"msg":"Incorrect username or password."}. The client
threw on it, so nothing was shown in chat, and the connection loop
treated it as a transient error and kept retrying.

- Read the 400 response as a rejected login instead of throwing
- Print the reason to chat and stop retrying

Close #742

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

aa78586: Update actions/create-github-app-token action to v3.3.0

bdadbad: Merge pull request #813 from SlashNephy/feat/faloop-release-report

feat(FaloopIntegration): notify when a scheduled spawn is released
33272b7: feat(FaloopIntegration): notify when a scheduled spawn is released

Scheduled spawns are visible only to early access reporters at first,
and released to everyone later. The spawn_release handler was removed in
ac3fe87, so the release was no longer notified.

- Mark the spawn report of a scheduled spawn with "(scheduled)"
- Add a per-rank "Enable Mob Release Report" option (disabled by
  default) to notify "has been released!" on spawn_release
- Keep the stored spawn up to date on spawn_release even when the
  option is disabled
- Accept ISO 8601 strings as well as epoch milliseconds for the release
  timestamp, as Faloop's web client does

Close #685

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
2fee79f: Merge pull request #812 from SlashNephy/fix/alic-queued-teleport-notification

fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): notify queued teleports only when they start
bc00f9c: fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): notify queued teleports only when they start

TeleportToQueuedAetheryte printed "Teleporting to ... (queued)" without
checking the result of ExecuteTeleport, so a queued teleport that
failed to start still showed the notification.

Refs #659

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
ed4a33d: Merge pull request #811 from SlashNephy/feat/faloop-spawn-sound

feat(FaloopIntegration): play a sound effect on spawn reports
223d58b: feat(FaloopIntegration): play a sound effect on spawn reports

Add a per-rank "Sound on Spawn Report" option:

- None (default)
- <se.1> to <se.16>, the same sounds as chat sound effects
- A custom UI sound effect ID, for sounds such as "Feature Unlocked"

The sound is played whenever a spawn report is printed to chat, and can
be previewed from the settings.

Close #464

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
6f7ea10: Merge pull request #810 from SlashNephy/feat/alic-print-conditions

feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add options to skip own messages and local Lifestream links
5b47730: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add options to skip own messages and local Lifestream links

- "Hide the Lifestream link for messages about the current world":
  skip the Lifestream link when the world detected from the message is
  the current world
- "Do not add teleport links to your own messages": skip messages sent
  by the local player

Both are disabled by default, so the current behaviour is unchanged.

Close #677

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
05acc63: Merge pull request #809 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-reconnect

fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection
47500d7: fix(FaloopIntegration): log the whole spawn_location payload

Passing the nullable ZonePoiId alone as the params argument of the log
call made it a null array when the value was null (CS8604). Log the
whole payload instead, as the spawn case does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
3cf9a9e: fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection

After "transport close", SocketIOClient's own reconnection kept the
engine.io session alive (pings continued) but the plugin never received
mob reports again until it was disabled and enabled.

Handle reconnection in the plugin instead, mirroring what re-enabling
the plugin does:

- Disable SocketIOClient's reconnection
- Run a connection loop that logs in again and connects with a new
  Socket.IO client on every disconnection, with exponential backoff
  from 5 seconds up to 5 minutes
- Time out a connection attempt that the server never accepts, since
  ConnectAsync only times out at the transport level
- Stop retrying when the credentials are rejected
- Ignore events from clients that have already been replaced

Refs #687

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
3e3cbf9: Merge pull request #808 from SlashNephy/docs/api13-repository

docs: describe the Dalamud API 13 repository
d2aee34: docs: describe the Dalamud API 13 repository

Point clients that are still on Dalamud API 13, such as the Traditional
Chinese client, to plugins/api13.json, which serves the frozen
AetheryteLinkInChat 7.3.1.14 build.

Refs #727

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
0f2ec49: Merge pull request #807 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-pending-spawn-location

fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later
6daa4d0: fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later

When "Ignore Pending Report" is enabled, a spawn reported without
coordinates was dropped before being stored, so the following
spawn_location could not find it and was ignored as well.

- Hold location-less spawns as pending and announce them once
  spawn_location arrives
- Accept a null zonePoiId in spawn_location and a singular zonePoiId in spawn
- Replace the stored report on location change instead of appending

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
8b422a6: Merge pull request #805 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-messaging-socket

fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint
01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

Close #804

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

74b4951: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add exits missing from the game's map markers

The game's map markers do not describe the exit from Yanxia to the
Doman Enclave (The One River): the marker in Yanxia points to the
obsolete map 437, and the current map 463 has no marker back to Yanxia.
So routes through the Doman Enclave were never considered, which is the
Yanxia example in #656.

- Add MapConnections for such exits, starting with Yanxia <-> the Doman
  Enclave. Comparing Faloop's boundary starting points with the game's
  map markers found no other missing exit
- Consider them in the route calculation as ConnectionTeleportPath,
  without counting the distance inside the connected map, as where the
  exit leads to is not known
- Show them like zone boundaries, and stop the Lifestream teleport there

Refs #656

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
a3c0a1f: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer Faloop's starting points for hunt spawn points

Straight-line distance on the map ignores terrain, height and walls, so
the nearest aetheryte is often not the best one to start from.

Faloop's zone data has the spawn points of hunt marks, each with a
journeyPoiId that points to the aetheryte or zone boundary to start
from. Embed them (generated by Scripts/generate_hunt_journeys.py) and,
when a map link is at a known spawn point, only consider the routes that
enter the map at its starting point. Otherwise, fall back to the
straight-line distance as before.

Refs #656

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
97ddbb9: Merge pull request #815 from SlashNephy/fix/alic-detect-world

fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer the world name after the cross world icon
e5d9e91: fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): prefer the world name after the cross world icon

DetectWorld picked the first public world in World sheet order whose
name appeared anywhere in the message. Mob names such as Odin and
Behemoth are also world names, so "Odin <map link> <CrossWorld>Cerberus"
resolved to Odin (row 66) instead of Cerberus (row 80), while
"Odin ... Omega" happened to work because Omega is row 39. The map link
trimming only removes text from the link marker (U+E0BB), so the mob
name before the link was kept.

- Prefer the world name right after the cross world icon, or the cross
  world character typed as text
- Otherwise use the world name that appears last in the message

Close #661

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
6ae42a0: Merge pull request #814 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-login-failure

fix(FaloopIntegration): report rejected logins instead of retrying
7900863: fix(FaloopIntegration): report rejected logins instead of retrying

Faloop responds to a login with wrong credentials with 400 and
{"success":false,"msg":"Incorrect username or password."}. The client
threw on it, so nothing was shown in chat, and the connection loop
treated it as a transient error and kept retrying.

- Read the 400 response as a rejected login instead of throwing
- Print the reason to chat and stop retrying

Close #742

bdadbad: Merge pull request #813 from SlashNephy/feat/faloop-release-report

feat(FaloopIntegration): notify when a scheduled spawn is released
33272b7: feat(FaloopIntegration): notify when a scheduled spawn is released

Scheduled spawns are visible only to early access reporters at first,
and released to everyone later. The spawn_release handler was removed in
ac3fe87, so the release was no longer notified.

- Mark the spawn report of a scheduled spawn with "(scheduled)"
- Add a per-rank "Enable Mob Release Report" option (disabled by
  default) to notify "has been released!" on spawn_release
- Keep the stored spawn up to date on spawn_release even when the
  option is disabled
- Accept ISO 8601 strings as well as epoch milliseconds for the release
  timestamp, as Faloop's web client does

Close #685

fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): notify queued teleports only when they start
bc00f9c: fix(AetheryteLinkInChat): notify queued teleports only when they start

TeleportToQueuedAetheryte printed "Teleporting to ... (queued)" without
checking the result of ExecuteTeleport, so a queued teleport that
failed to start still showed the notification.

Refs #659

feat(FaloopIntegration): play a sound effect on spawn reports
223d58b: feat(FaloopIntegration): play a sound effect on spawn reports

Add a per-rank "Sound on Spawn Report" option:

- None (default)
- <se.1> to <se.16>, the same sounds as chat sound effects
- A custom UI sound effect ID, for sounds such as "Feature Unlocked"

The sound is played whenever a spawn report is printed to chat, and can
be previewed from the settings.

Close #464

6f7ea10: Merge pull request #810 from SlashNephy/feat/alic-print-conditions

feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add options to skip own messages and local Lifestream links
5b47730: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add options to skip own messages and local Lifestream links

- "Hide the Lifestream link for messages about the current world":
  skip the Lifestream link when the world detected from the message is
  the current world
- "Do not add teleport links to your own messages": skip messages sent
  by the local player

Both are disabled by default, so the current behaviour is unchanged.

Close #677

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
05acc63: Merge pull request #809 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-reconnect

fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection
47500d7: fix(FaloopIntegration): log the whole spawn_location payload

Passing the nullable ZonePoiId alone as the params argument of the log
call made it a null array when the value was null (CS8604). Log the
whole payload instead, as the spawn case does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
3cf9a9e: fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection

After "transport close", SocketIOClient's own reconnection kept the
engine.io session alive (pings continued) but the plugin never received
mob reports again until it was disabled and enabled.

Handle reconnection in the plugin instead, mirroring what re-enabling
the plugin does:

- Disable SocketIOClient's reconnection
- Run a connection loop that logs in again and connects with a new
  Socket.IO client on every disconnection, with exponential backoff
  from 5 seconds up to 5 minutes
- Time out a connection attempt that the server never accepts, since
  ConnectAsync only times out at the transport level
- Stop retrying when the credentials are rejected
- Ignore events from clients that have already been replaced

Refs #687

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: describe the Dalamud API 13 repository
d2aee34: docs: describe the Dalamud API 13 repository

Point clients that are still on Dalamud API 13, such as the Traditional
Chinese client, to plugins/api13.json, which serves the frozen
AetheryteLinkInChat 7.3.1.14 build.

Refs #727

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
0f2ec49: Merge pull request #807 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-pending-spawn-location

fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later
6daa4d0: fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later

When "Ignore Pending Report" is enabled, a spawn reported without
coordinates was dropped before being stored, so the following
spawn_location could not find it and was ignored as well.

- Hold location-less spawns as pending and announce them once
  spawn_location arrives
- Accept a null zonePoiId in spawn_location and a singular zonePoiId in spawn
- Replace the stored report on location change instead of appending

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
8b422a6: Merge pull request #805 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-messaging-socket

fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint
01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

Close #804

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

plugins.changelog:
Tales of Milestones:
- Eat buttons on the Bonuses tab. Each meal in your inventory has an Eat button. One click eats one meal. The button is not available when the game refuses the meal.
- Eat button in /tm food. The food window has the same button for a meal that is in your inventory.
- /tm eat. `/tm eat dps`, `tank`, `healer`, `battle`, `craft`, `gather` or `all` eats your meal of that kind when you hold only one such meal. When you hold more than one, the Bonuses tab opens and you select the meal.
- Playtime in the export. The export adds the time that the plugin recorded after your last `/playtime` reply, so the playtime is current at the time of the export. The plugin does not run `/playtime`.
- Armor, GARO and more weapons in the export. "Copy collections" and "Copy everything" now include relic armor, GARO gear, and the Figmental, Exquisite and Deep Dungeon weapons.
- The native windows use less processor time. The at-a-glance window and the tabs of the main window now update one time each second, not on each frame. In a test, the at-a-glance window changed from about 1.2 ms to about 0.08 ms for each frame.
- Fix: the plugin no longer writes its settings file every 5 seconds while Cosmic Exploration data is loaded. It writes the file only when a tool's progress changes.
- Fix: the job list on the Progression tab no longer scrolls past its end.
- KamiToolKit is updated to its current version.
Adventurer's Ledger (Pandora Lunar):
- New layout. Next Steps is the first screen. It shows 5 cards for what to do next, and "Show 5 more" shows 10. Daily, Weekly and Seasonal rows are below it in the rail. The header shows the area title, the age of your data and 4 clocks.
- Challenge Log. Each Challenge Log entry has its own row, with links and typed counts. Suggested and Completed groups are included.
- Routine sub-checks. A routine can have its own boxes: one for each roulette, a Tank You pick, 12 allied society boxes and Grand Company chips. "Edit routines" changes the rows.
- Relics by job. The Relics area has a By job view and line cards with progress bars. To fill the Armor and GARO frames, update Tales of Milestones to this version and import a new export.
- Societies, currents and collections. Societies show unlock lines and rank bars. Aether currents are listed by zone. Collections are grouped by availability, with Online Store links.
- Settings area. Character, display, and backup and import settings are in one area. The Ledger holds up to 8 characters, and times can show in UTC or local time.
- Themes. The three themes are Lunar night, Crystarium and Light. Expansion tags use the colours of the Lodestone patch notes.
- Jobs meter. The rail has a Jobs meter that adds your combat, crafting and gathering levels, out of 3,330.
- Fix: after an import, the relic row in the list of changes counts relic items. Before, a stage upgrade showed no change, for example "9 to 9".

rawManifest.Name: Tales of Milestones
rawManifest.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
rawManifest.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.

- Fixed an issue where (L) leves weren't being considered for grabbing even though they were the only thing left
- Fixed an issue where the level check just... didn't level check??? (woops)
- Fixed an issue where the cost amount wasn't working as intended

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description: A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugins.punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON
plugins.description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugins.changelog: - Cosmic will only enable autohook if it needs to start a fishing mission, will not try and disable it.

plugins.author: nxships
plugins.name: PlayerNexusTracker
plugins.punchline: Track every adventurer you meet in Eorzea.
plugins.description:
Track players you meet in FFXIV — who they are, when you ran into them, how their characters change over time. A focused social tracker built on the NexusKit framework.

Per-player detail view with Summary, Equipment, Class/Jobs, Achievements, Free Company, Encounters, History and Notes tabs. Optional enrichment from Lodestone (gear, FC link, achievement progress) and FFXIVCollect (mounts, minions, full achievement catalog). Live throttled refresh queue keeps external data fresh without hammering either service.

Configurable chat and toast notifications when players you've seen before change — rename, server transfer, Free Company join/leave/switch, achievement growth, refresh failures. Per-event filtering and history grouping so the chat doesn't drown you.

Powerful player-filter language with live preview to slice your list however you want; encounter history scoped per duty and content type; optional bridges to other Dalamud plugins (Lifestream world-travel, more to come).

Local-first: all data lives in a single SQLite file under your XIVLauncher config. Automated weekly maintenance keeps it tidy. English and German localization.
plugins.changelog:
## What's Changed
* fix: guard detail header table setup by @nxships in https://github.com/NexusFFXIV/PlayerNexusTracker/pull/65

plugins.author: NightmareXIV
plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!
plugins.changelog:
- Library updates
- Improvements to map effect tab

plugins.name: Chilled Leves
plugins.punchline: I heard you like your leves on the rocks.
plugins.description: The leve plugin that nobody wanted to make. Will display what leves you need to complete, as well as help automate them for your heart desires (not required though)
plugins.changelog:
- Added a minimum interaction delay before event attempting to do anything with grabbing leves
	- It's 100ms
	- This is moreso to prevent people from crashing due to (what I can only assume) to be ping -> server information
	- The setting takes a higher priority, so if you set it to like 500, it'll respect the 500
- Fixed an issue where (L) leves weren't being considered for grabbing even though they were the only thing left
- Fixed an issue where the level check just... didn't level check??? (woops)
- Fixed an issue where the cost amount wasn't working as intended

plugins.author: Ice
plugins.name: Gather & Chill
plugins.punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.description: A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.
plugins.changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.author: Aida Enna
plugins.name: Macro Chain Redux
plugins.punchline: A modified fork of the old Macro Chain that allows you to run multiple macros one after the other (or repeat them).
plugins.description:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

plugins.author: The Combat Reborn Team
plugins.name: Rotation Solver Reborn
plugins.punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
plugins.description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.

plugins.author: NightmareXIV
plugins.name: Splatoon
plugins.punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
plugins.description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

plugins.author: dajoey
plugins.name: PvP Solver
plugins.punchline: PvP-only auto-rotation
plugins.description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
plugins.changelog:
v0.1.2.15 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.1.2.14 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.


- **Removed the AI decision layer.** The optional relayed decision model (focus picking, Limit Break firing and the healer-call shadow lines, with their "call the shots" settings row and its relay address field) is gone from the plugin. No fight snapshot is built or sent anywhere anymore, and the plugin makes no decision calls of any kind.
- Targeting, Guard, Recuperate, the defensive table, StickyTarget and every other rotation behavior are unchanged. The defensive rules keep reading real HP (current HP out of the maximum) under the neutral name `RealHp.HpRatio`; no threshold or default moved.
- PvP Solver still never moves the character and never fires a PvP Limit Break on its own logic, exactly as before.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.


- **The Jev co-pilot logs the plain code rule's answer beside Jev's, for both of its questions.** Each `JV|focus-pick` line names the enemy Jev picked and the enemy the plain rule would pick (the lowest-HP enemy in attack range); each `JV|lb-shadow` line names Jev's Limit Break call and the code rule's. Both answers are recorded side by side and graded after the session, to show which one decides better. Log only: targeting, Limit Break firing and every other behavior are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.


- Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn a560469db): the rotation engine now builds in upstream's merged single-project layout.
- Ports upstream engine fixes: the action manager is read at call time instead of a pointer cached at startup (a stale-pointer crash class), configuration saves are atomic (write to a temp file, then replace), and the shield-value calculation can no longer overflow on very large HP values.
- No rotation behavior change; the 21 PvP rotations and their presets are untouched.

v0.1.2.10 (2026-11-01) [testing]
- **The per-job defensive actions also read real HP.** Heart of Corundum, Tempera Coat, Earth's Reply, Riddle of Earth, the Bloodbath rows, Lady of Crowns, Microcosmos, Meisui, Impalement, Xenoglossy's low-HP arm and Shadowbringer's HP arm compared their "use below this HP" thresholds against predicted HP, which counts heals still on the way; predicted can read 84% one second before a death at about 40% real HP. They now compare against the current HP out of the maximum, the same real value Guard and the defensive table already use. Thresholds and defaults are unchanged, and reads of enemies' and allies' HP (Smite, Guardian, Blasting Zone, Perfectio, the burst target) are untouched.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v0.1.2.9 (2026-11-01) [testing]
- **Self-defence now reads real HP.** Guard, Recuperate and the generic defensive actions (the "use below X% HP" table) compared their thresholds against predicted HP, which counts heals still on the way; predicted can read 84% one second before a death at about 40% real HP, so nothing fired. All of them now compare against the current HP out of the maximum, the same real value the Jev snapshot uses. Thresholds and defaults are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v0.1.2.8 (2026-10-31) [testing]
- **"Let Jev call the shots" now sees real HP.** The player's and allies' HP sent to Jev is the current HP out of the maximum, no longer PvP Solver's predicted HP, which counts heals still on the way. In one match Jev was told 84% one second before a death at about 40%.
- **Jev's pick no longer drops when Jev is briefly unsure.** The relay now keeps the last pick itself while that enemy is still hittable, and drops it on purpose when the enemy goes under Guard, out of reach or stale. PvP Solver follows the relay's call and never brings a dropped pick back. Only with an older relay does PvP Solver keep the last pick, for up to three seconds after Jev gave it, while that enemy is still a valid target.
- **The Limit Break log matches what happened.** `JV|lb-fired` is written once when the Limit Break goes off in a fire window. `JV|lb-fire-skip` is written only when a window closes without it, with the reason: unusable, follow-up, out-of-range, no-target or timeout. A report of the use that arrives up to two seconds late still counts as fired. Before, a skip line could appear in windows that then fired, and windows that really failed wrote nothing.
- **Each action used is reported once.** The game reports each action twice; the same action on the same target within 1.5 seconds now counts once in the snapshot.
- **Alliance members are included (Frontline).** After the party members, the nearest alliance members are sent too, marked as alliance, up to eight allies in all. Each ally now carries its object id, so Jev can name an ally to heal.
- **Healer call, logged only.** When Jev suggests whom a healer should heal (an ally, self, attack or Guard), the suggestion is written as one `JV|heal-shadow` log line for the first suggestion in each fight and each time it changes; an answer with no suggestion does not count as a change. Nothing acts on it yet.
- **Relay failures are visible in the log.** One summary line per fight (when combat ends, or every 60 seconds while calls fail) counts calls that succeeded, timed out, got an error reply or failed. No line per call, and no call is counted in a later fight. An unreadable heal or Limit Break value in a reply no longer drops the rest of the answer.
- PvP Solver still never moves the character.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.1.2.7 (2026-10-29) [testing]
- **"Let Jev call the shots" reports what actually happened.** Each snapshot also carries the player's current target and the actions actually used since the last one (action and target only), so each of Jev's picks can be checked against what PvP Solver did and whether that enemy went down.
- Jev's focus pick is kept steady: it moves to another enemy only when that one is clearly the better pick.
- **A line, cone or splash Limit Break that Jev called could be skipped** because the action kept its own "most enemies" target. It is now aimed at the enemy Jev chose, which the game has just confirmed as a valid target. A skipped fire writes one reason line to the log.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

plugins.author: dajoey
plugins.name: AutoPotion
plugins.punchline: Per-job HP, MP, and deep dungeon potion automation.
plugins.description: Auto-uses the highest-tier HP potion, MP potion (Ether), and the deep dungeon regen potion (Sustaining / Eurekan / Orthos / Pilgrim's) at configurable thresholds. Each potion's threshold and on/off state is stored per-job, so casters and tanks can have completely different setups.
plugins.changelog:
v0.2.5.4 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents across every page. All settings, presets and automation behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.2.5.3 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v0.2.5.2 (2026-10-10) [testing]
- **Automatic item uses no longer cancel an open action sequence.** Any potion, ether, deep dungeon medicine or Echo Drops that would land while mudra seals or Ten Chi Jin are held is delayed until the sequence completes, instead of cancelling the ninjutsu mid-chain. The delay lasts only while the sequence is up (a mudra window is about six seconds) and lifts immediately after; at or below 25% HP the heal fires regardless - a cancelled jutsu is cheaper than dying. No other job's behaviour changes.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
- With the optional decision log enabled, a held use is recorded with the `heldmudra` near-miss reason, rate-limited like every other near-miss line.

v0.2.5.1 (2026-10-03) [testing]
- **Quick controls for the Lazy Hub window.** The plugin now offers the master switch, "Only in combat", "Only in a duty", the HP, MP and Regen potion switches with their thresholds, and Cure Silence (Echo Drops) to Lazy Hub (`/lazy`) over Dalamud IPC, so they can be changed from one window next to the other lalalazy plugins. Each change does exactly what the matching setting in the plugin's own window does.
- The potion settings apply to the active job's profile, as in the settings window.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
- Without Lazy Hub installed the plugin behaves exactly as before.

v0.2.5.0 (2026-09-05)

- New per-job option: "Auto-use Echo Drops when silenced". When it is on and Silence lands (mob silence spells, AoE silences, deep dungeon traps), AutoPotion uses Echo Drops from inventory to cure it automatically. Item use is not blocked by Silence, so the cure works exactly when nothing else can.
- OFF by default like every option, and per job like the rest: tick the new box in the settings window for the jobs it should apply to. With it off (the default) nothing changes - not even a status check.
- It reuses the same machinery as the potions: HQ Echo Drops are preferred over normal ones, the shared 750 ms cooldown after any potion use applies, and a Silence that arrives during that cooldown is cured on the next tick.
- If the diagnostic tap is enabled, the cure logs as an `e` event; when it cannot fire the near-miss reasons are `edblocked` (on cooldown / blocked) or `ednostock` (none in the bags).
- No change to potion behaviour. HP/MP/regen thresholds, the overshoot guard, the deep dungeon Rehabilitation lockout and the in-combat / in-duty gates all work exactly as before.

v0.2.4.0 (2026-09-05)

- Added an optional "Log potion decisions" diagnostic, OFF by default. Turn it on with `/autopotion telemetry on` or the new Advanced / Diagnostics section of the settings window, and AutoPotion writes one line to its plugin log every time it uses a potion, plus a rate-limited line when a threshold was crossed and nothing fired.
- Purpose: the log line records the HP%, the MP%, the threshold that was in force and the job, so a threshold can be verified after the fact instead of guessed at. Nothing leaves the machine - the lines only go to the local Dalamud plugin log.
- The "nothing fired" lines say WHY in a short code: `hpover` (a potion was available but the heal would have been wasted), `hpblocked` / `mpblocked` / `rgblocked` (on cooldown or blocked by a status), `hpnostock` / `mpnostock` / `rgnostock` (none left in inventory) and `rgrehab` (Rehabilitation still up in a deep dungeon).
- These lines are heavily rate-limited on purpose: a repeated state logs once, not once per frame. Measured against 214 minutes of real play the near-miss lines come out under one line per minute, so the log stays readable.
- No change to potion behaviour. Thresholds, per-job profiles, the overshoot guard, the deep dungeon Rehabilitation lockout and the in-combat / in-duty gates all work exactly as before, and with the setting off (the default) the plugin does not even build a log line.
